meta.core_history_note: Complete China-reported country-month HS 8703 history remains in exports.json through the latest UN Comtrade China release.
meta.methodology: Current layer keeps unlike sources separate: GACC for complete aggregate USD and public top-20 destination values; partner-reported Comtrade mirror for available monthly destination units/value; Gasgoo for a cumulative top-10 passenger-vehicle unit benchmark.

gacc.source: GACC via China Data Portal public HS4 API
gacc.note: Monthly total USD value covers all GACC partner rows. Public destination detail is limited to the latest top 20 partners and does not expose quantity.

mirror.source: UN Comtrade destination-reported imports from China
mirror.scope: HS 8703 imports where partner=China; partner-country mirror of Chinese exports
mirror.note: Mirror coverage depends on destination-country reporting schedules. Import values are generally CIF and are not directly comparable with China-reported FOB export values. Country-level units remain useful as a current direction-of-travel check.

volume_benchmark.scope: Cumulative passenger-vehicle exports by destination; top 10 only
